(* 1RB0RE_1RC0RA_0LD0RB_1LA0LE_1LC1LF_0LC--- halts.
   Bell eats counter.  At a round start the tape is the K-form
     K X b c = X <* [0] {{E}}> bellw b c *> 0inf,   bellw b c = 101 (001)^b 0001 (001)^c,
   with a counter word X left of the head (3-cell digits, lowest digit nearest the head).
   A round makes one call into the counter (entered in C on its low cell, left in B on the
   boundary cell) and then moves the defect one block left: callw X X' gives
   K X (S b) c -->+ K X' b (S c) ([round]).  On clean digits (001, 000, 101, 100 read as
   -1, 0, 1, 2, balanced base 4) the call adds 1 ([callw_inc]), so n rounds add n to the clean
   low part of the word in closed form ([rounds], [addn], [batch]).  The other rounds (a carry
   into a dirty digit) and every eat (b = 0, where the bell eats the counter) are run by a
   verified run-length macro simulator of tm up to the next K-form ([mstep], [isK], [urun]):
   a side is a list of runs (block, count) before 0inf, and a macro step is either one step of
   tm or a block rule, found at run time by a window simulation of the block with 0 to 2
   context cells and crossed by shift_rule_L / shift_rule_R of verify/Individual62.v.
   Iterating the checker [next] from the configuration reached after 288 steps ([init],
   K 0inf 0 2) reaches a halting configuration after 4,942,483 iterations (611,578 eats,
   2,234,211 batches, 2,096,694 simulated rounds, 300,612,334 macro steps): in the 7,435th
   round after the eat of the cycle that starts with c = 1,218,828, F reads a 1, about 1.8e18
   steps after the start.  The run is checked in 751 chunks of about 400,000 macro steps
   ([run_ok], [run_halt], [s1] .. [s751]) between literal states [k1] .. [k750].
   Adapted from verify/Sk1Machines.v (Module Sk1Auto: a checked certificate runner over
   Eqb.N_iter_until and N_iter_until_spec); the round, digit and bell lemmas are proved by es
   of verify/Individual62.v, and the start by solve_init.
   Informal proof: the accompanying write-up.
   Formalized with Claude Code (Anthropic, AI-assisted); corrections from an independent
   audit by GPT-6 Astra (OpenAI).
   Checked: compiles against unmodified busycoq BB6 (commit 0940bb9) with Coq 8.20.1;
   Print Assumptions halt: Closed under the global context. *)

From BusyCoq Require Import Individual62 Eqb.
Require Import ZifyNat ZifyN Lia NArith ZArith PeanoNat String List.
Open Scope sym_scope.
Open Scope list.

Definition tm := Eval compute in (TM_from_str "1RB0RE_1RC0RA_0LD0RB_1LA0LE_1LC1LF_0LC---").
Notation "c -->* c'" := (c -[ tm ]->* c') (at level 40).
Notation "c -->+ c'" := (c -[ tm ]->+ c') (at level 40).

(** * Rounds *)
Definition bellw b c : list Sym := [1;0;1] ++ [0;0;1]^^b ++ [0;0;0;1] ++ [0;0;1]^^c.
Definition K (X:side) b c : Q * tape := X <* [0] {{E}}> bellw b c *> 0inf.
Definition callw (X X':side) := forall r, X <{{C}} 0 >> r -->* X' {{B}}> 0 >> r.

Lemma bellpart X b c: X {{B}}> 0 >> bellw (S b) c *> 0inf -->+ K X b (S c).
Proof. unfold K, bellw. es. Qed.

Lemma round X X' b c: callw X X' -> K X (S b) c -->+ K X' b (S c).
Proof.
  intros H. eapply evstep_progress_trans. 2: apply bellpart.
  change (K X (S b) c) with (X <* [0] {{E}}> 1 >> (([0;1] ++ [0;0;1]^^(S b) ++ [0;0;0;1] ++ [0;0;1]^^c) *> 0inf)).
  do 2 step1. follow H. apply evstep_refl.
Qed.

Inductive dg := Dm | D0 | D1 | D2.
Definition dcell (d:dg) : list Sym := match d with
  | Dm => [1;0;0] | D0 => [0;0;0] | D1 => [1;0;1] | D2 => [0;0;1] end.
Fixpoint cells (ds:list dg) : list Sym := match ds with [] => [] | d::r => dcell d ++ cells r end.
Fixpoint inc (ds:list dg) : option (list dg) := match ds with
  | [] => None
  | D2 :: r => match inc r with Some r' => Some (Dm :: r') | None => None end
  | Dm :: r => Some (D0 :: r) | D0 :: r => Some (D1 :: r) | D1 :: r => Some (D2 :: r) end.

Lemma absm H: callw ([1;0;0] *> H) ([0;0;0] *> H).
Proof. unfold callw. es. Qed.
Lemma abs0 H: callw ([0;0;0] *> H) ([1;0;1] *> H).
Proof. unfold callw. es. Qed.
Lemma abs1 H: callw ([1;0;1] *> H) ([0;0;1] *> H).
Proof. unfold callw. es. Qed.
Lemma pass2 X X': callw X X' -> callw ([0;0;1] *> X) ([1;0;0] *> X').
Proof.
  unfold callw. intros H r. cbn [Str_app].
  do 5 step1. follow H. es.
Qed.

Lemma callw_inc ds: forall ds' H, inc ds = Some ds' -> callw (cells ds *> H) (cells ds' *> H).
Proof.
  induction ds as [|d r IH]; intros ds' H E; [discriminate|].
  destruct d; cbn [inc] in E.
  - injection E as <-. cbn [cells dcell]. rewrite !Str_app_assoc. apply absm.
  - injection E as <-. cbn [cells dcell]. rewrite !Str_app_assoc. apply abs0.
  - injection E as <-. cbn [cells dcell]. rewrite !Str_app_assoc. apply abs1.
  - destruct (inc r) as [r'|] eqn:E2; [|discriminate]. injection E as <-.
    cbn [cells dcell]. rewrite !Str_app_assoc. apply pass2, IH. reflexivity.
Qed.

Lemma round_inc ds ds' H b c: inc ds = Some ds' ->
  K (cells ds *> H) (S b) c -->+ K (cells ds' *> H) b (S c).
Proof. intros E. apply round, callw_inc, E. Qed.

(** * Balanced base-4 values *)
Definition dv (d:dg) : Z := match d with Dm => (-1)%Z | D0 => 0%Z | D1 => 1%Z | D2 => 2%Z end.
Fixpoint val (ds:list dg) : Z := match ds with [] => 0%Z | d::r => (dv d + 4 * val r)%Z end.
Fixpoint maxv (f:nat) : Z := match f with O => 0%Z | S f => (2 + 4 * maxv f)%Z end.

Lemma val_le_maxv ds: (val ds <= maxv (length ds))%Z.
Proof. induction ds as [|d r IH]; cbn [val maxv length]; [lia|]. destruct d; cbn [dv]; lia. Qed.

Lemma val_inj ds: forall ds', length ds' = length ds -> val ds' = val ds -> ds' = ds.
Proof.
  induction ds as [|d r IH]; intros [|d' r'] E1 E2; cbn [length val] in *; try discriminate; auto.
  assert (d' = d /\ val r' = val r) as [-> E3].
  { destruct d, d'; cbn [dv] in E2; try (exfalso; lia); split; auto; lia. }
  f_equal. apply IH; auto.
Qed.

Lemma inc_some ds: (val ds < maxv (length ds))%Z -> exists ds', inc ds = Some ds'.
Proof.
  induction ds as [|d r IH]; cbn [val maxv length]; [lia|]. intros Hl.
  destruct d; cbn [inc]; eauto.
  destruct IH as [r' ->]; [cbn [dv] in Hl; lia|]. eauto.
Qed.

Lemma inc_val ds: forall ds', inc ds = Some ds' -> length ds' = length ds /\ val ds' = (val ds + 1)%Z.
Proof.
  induction ds as [|d r IH]; intros ds' E; [discriminate|].
  destruct d; cbn [inc] in E.
  - injection E as <-. cbn [length val dv]. split; [reflexivity|lia].
  - injection E as <-. cbn [length val dv]. split; [reflexivity|lia].
  - injection E as <-. cbn [length val dv]. split; [reflexivity|lia].
  - destruct (inc r) as [r'|] eqn:E2; [|discriminate]. injection E as <-.
    destruct (IH r' eq_refl) as [L V]. cbn [length val dv]. split; [congruence|lia].
Qed.

Lemma rounds n: forall ds ds' H b c, length ds' = length ds -> val ds' = (val ds + Z.of_nat n)%Z ->
  K (cells ds *> H) (n + b) c -->* K (cells ds' *> H) b (n + c).
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IH]; intros ds ds' H b c E1 E2.
  - assert (ds' = ds) by (apply val_inj; auto; lia). subst. apply evstep_refl.
  - assert (Hlt: (val ds < maxv (length ds))%Z).
    { pose proof (val_le_maxv ds') as M. rewrite E1 in M. lia. }
    destruct (inc_some ds Hlt) as [ds1 Ei].
    destruct (inc_val ds ds1 Ei) as [L1 V1].
    eapply evstep_trans. { apply progress_evstep. apply (round_inc ds ds1 H (n + b) c Ei). }
    replace (S n + c) with (n + S c) by lia.
    apply IH; lia.
Qed.

(** digit-wise addition of k >= 0 to a balanced base-4 word (no carry out) *)
Definition dg_of_mod (t:Z) : dg :=
  if Z.eqb (t mod 4) 0 then D0 else if Z.eqb (t mod 4) 1 then D1 else if Z.eqb (t mod 4) 2 then D2 else Dm.
Lemma dg_of_mod_spec t: (4 * ((t - dv (dg_of_mod t)) / 4) = t - dv (dg_of_mod t))%Z.
Proof.
  unfold dg_of_mod.
  destruct (Z.eqb_spec (t mod 4) 0); [cbn [dv]; Z.div_mod_to_equations; lia|].
  destruct (Z.eqb_spec (t mod 4) 1); [cbn [dv]; Z.div_mod_to_equations; lia|].
  destruct (Z.eqb_spec (t mod 4) 2); [cbn [dv]; Z.div_mod_to_equations; lia|].
  cbn [dv]. Z.div_mod_to_equations; lia.
Qed.

Fixpoint addn (ds:list dg) (k:Z) : option (list dg) :=
  if Z.eqb k 0 then Some ds else
  match ds with
  | [] => None
  | d::r =>
    let t := (dv d + k)%Z in
    let e := dg_of_mod t in
    match addn r ((t - dv e) / 4)%Z with Some r' => Some (e::r') | None => None end
  end.

Lemma addn_spec ds: forall k ds', addn ds k = Some ds' -> length ds' = length ds /\ val ds' = (val ds + k)%Z.
Proof.
  induction ds as [|d r IH]; intros k ds' E; cbn [addn] in E.
  - destruct (Z.eqb_spec k 0); [|discriminate]. injection E as <-. cbn. lia.
  - destruct (Z.eqb_spec k 0) as [->|Hk].
    { injection E as <-. split; [reflexivity|lia]. }
    destruct (addn r _) as [r'|] eqn:E2; [|discriminate]. injection E as <-.
    destruct (IH _ _ E2) as [L V]. cbn [length val]. split; [congruence|].
    rewrite V. pose proof (dg_of_mod_spec (dv d + k)). lia.
Qed.

(** * Run-length sides and the macro simulator *)
Definition seqb (a b:Sym) : bool := match a, b with S0, S0 => true | S1, S1 => true | _, _ => false end.
Lemma seqb_eq a b: seqb a b = true -> a = b.
Proof. destruct a, b; cbn; congruence. Qed.
Fixpoint lsym_eqb (u v:list Sym) : bool := match u, v with
  | [], [] => true | x::u', y::v' => if seqb x y then lsym_eqb u' v' else false | _, _ => false end.
Lemma lsym_eqb_eq u: forall v, lsym_eqb u v = true -> u = v.
Proof.
  induction u as [|x u IH]; intros [|y v]; cbn; try congruence.
  destruct (seqb x y) eqn:H1; [|discriminate]. intros H2.
  apply seqb_eq in H1. apply IH in H2. subst. reflexivity.
Qed.
Definition qeqb (a b:Q) : bool := match a, b with
  | A, A => true | B, B => true | C, C => true | D, D => true | E, E => true | F, F => true | _, _ => false end.
Lemma qeqb_eq a b: qeqb a b = true -> a = b.
Proof. destruct a, b; cbn; congruence. Qed.

Definition sd := list (list Sym * N).
Fixpoint sdn (s:sd) : side := match s with [] => const S0 | (u,n)::s' => u ^^ (N.to_nat n) *> sdn s' end.

Lemma lpow_nil {T} n: ([]:list T)^^n = [].
Proof. induction n; cbn; auto. Qed.
Lemma lpow1 (u:list Sym) r: u ^^ 1 *> r = u *> r.
Proof. cbn [lpow]. rewrite app_nil_r. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma lpow_rot (z:Sym) u1 m: (z::u1)^^(S m) = z :: ((u1 ++ [z])^^m ++ u1).
Proof.
  change ((z::u1)^^(S m)) with ((z::u1) ++ (z::u1)^^m). rewrite <-lpow_shift.
  rewrite lpow_rotate_list. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition consr (u:list Sym) (rest:sd) : sd := match u with [] => rest | _ => (u,1%N)::rest end.
Lemma consr_spec u rest: sdn (consr u rest) = u *> sdn rest.
Proof. destruct u; [reflexivity|]. cbn [consr sdn]. apply lpow1. Qed.

Definition pop_run (z:Sym) (u1:list Sym) (n:N) (rest:sd) : Sym * sd :=
  if N.eqb n 1 then (z, consr u1 rest) else (z, (u1 ++ [z], N.pred n) :: consr u1 rest).
Fixpoint pop (s:sd) : Sym * sd := match s with
  | [] => (S0, [])
  | (u,n)::rest => match u with
    | [] => pop rest
    | z::u1 => if N.eqb n 0 then pop rest else pop_run z u1 n rest end end.

Lemma pop_spec s: forall z s', pop s = (z, s') -> sdn s = z >> sdn s'.
Proof.
  induction s as [|[u n] s IH]; intros z s' E; cbn [pop] in E.
  - injection E as <- <-. apply const_unfold.
  - destruct u as [|z0 u1].
    + cbn [sdn]. rewrite lpow_nil. apply IH, E.
    + destruct (N.eqb_spec n 0) as [->|Hn].
      * cbn [sdn N.to_nat lpow Str_app]. apply IH, E.
      * unfold pop_run in E. cbn [sdn].
        destruct (N.eqb_spec n 1) as [->|Hn1]; injection E as <- <-.
        -- rewrite lpow1. rewrite consr_spec. reflexivity.
        -- replace (N.to_nat n) with (S (N.to_nat (N.pred n))) by lia.
           rewrite lpow_rot. cbn [Str_app sdn]. rewrite consr_spec, Str_app_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition allz (u:list Sym) : bool := forallb (fun x => seqb x S0) u.
Lemma allz_spec u: allz u = true -> u *> const S0 = const S0.
Proof.
  induction u as [|x u IH]; cbn; [reflexivity|]. intros H; apply andb_prop in H as [H1 H2].
  apply seqb_eq in H1; subst. rewrite IH by exact H2. symmetry. apply const_unfold.
Qed.

Definition push_block (s:sd) (u:list Sym) (n:N) : sd := match s with
  | [] => if allz u then [] else [(u,n)]
  | (v,m)::rest => if lsym_eqb u v then (v, (n+m)%N)::rest else (u,n)::s end.
Lemma push_block_spec s u n: sdn (push_block s u n) = u^^(N.to_nat n) *> sdn s.
Proof.
  destruct s as [|[v m] rest]; cbn [push_block].
  - destruct (allz u) eqn:H; cbn [sdn]; [|reflexivity]. rewrite lpow_all0; [reflexivity|]. apply allz_spec, H.
  - destruct (lsym_eqb u v) eqn:H; [|reflexivity]. apply lsym_eqb_eq in H; subst. cbn [sdn].
    rewrite N2Nat.inj_add, lpow_add, Str_app_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* three singletons followed by a run of their block, or six singletons forming a block twice, become a run *)
Definition fold6 (a b c:Sym) (rest s:sd) : sd := match rest with
  | ([d],n4)::([e],n5)::([f],n6)::rest' =>
    if N.eqb n4 1 then if N.eqb n5 1 then if N.eqb n6 1 then
    if lsym_eqb [a;b;c] [d;e;f] then if seqb a b then if seqb b c then s else ([a;b;c], 2%N)::rest'
    else ([a;b;c], 2%N)::rest' else s else s else s else s
  | _ => s end.
Definition fold3 (s:sd) : sd := match s with
  | ([a],n1)::([b],n2)::([c],n3)::rest =>
    if N.eqb n1 1 then if N.eqb n2 1 then if N.eqb n3 1 then
      match rest with
      | (v,m)::rest' => if lsym_eqb [a;b;c] v then ([a;b;c], N.succ m)::rest' else fold6 a b c rest s
      | [] => s end
    else s else s else s
  | _ => s end.

Lemma fold6_spec a b c rest s: sdn s = a >> b >> c >> sdn rest -> sdn (fold6 a b c rest s) = sdn s.
Proof.
  intros Hs. unfold fold6.
  destruct rest as [|[[|d [|]] n4] rest]; try reflexivity.
  destruct rest as [|[[|e [|]] n5] rest]; try reflexivity.
  destruct rest as [|[[|f [|]] n6] rest]; try reflexivity.
  destruct (N.eqb_spec n4 1); try reflexivity. destruct (N.eqb_spec n5 1); try reflexivity.
  destruct (N.eqb_spec n6 1); try reflexivity. subst.
  destruct (lsym_eqb [a;b;c] [d;e;f]) eqn:H; try reflexivity. apply lsym_eqb_eq in H. injection H as <- <- <-.
  assert (G: sdn (([a;b;c], 2%N)::rest) = sdn s).
  { rewrite Hs. reflexivity. }
  destruct (seqb a b); [destruct (seqb b c)|]; try reflexivity; exact G.
Qed.

Lemma fold3_spec s: sdn (fold3 s) = sdn s.
Proof.
  unfold fold3.
  destruct s as [|[[|a [|]] n1] s]; try reflexivity.
  destruct s as [|[[|b [|]] n2] s]; try reflexivity.
  destruct s as [|[[|c [|]] n3] s]; try reflexivity.
  destruct (N.eqb_spec n1 1); try reflexivity. destruct (N.eqb_spec n2 1); try reflexivity.
  destruct (N.eqb_spec n3 1); try reflexivity. subst.
  destruct s as [|[v m] s]; try reflexivity.
  destruct (lsym_eqb [a;b;c] v) eqn:H.
  - apply lsym_eqb_eq in H. subst. cbn [sdn]. rewrite N2Nat.inj_succ. reflexivity.
  - apply fold6_spec. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition push (s:sd) (x:Sym) : sd := fold3 (push_block s [x] 1%N).
Lemma push_spec s x: sdn (push s x) = x >> sdn s.
Proof. unfold push. rewrite fold3_spec, push_block_spec. reflexivity. Qed.

Fixpoint take (k:nat) (s:sd) : list Sym * sd := match k with
  | O => ([], s)
  | S k' => let (z, s1) := pop s in let (zs, s2) := take k' s1 in (z::zs, s2) end.
Lemma take_spec k: forall s zs s', take k s = (zs, s') -> sdn s = zs *> sdn s'.
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros s zs s' E; cbn [take] in E.
  - injection E as <- <-. reflexivity.
  - destruct (pop s) as [z s1] eqn:E1. destruct (take k s1) as [zs1 s2] eqn:E2. injection E as <- <-.
    rewrite (pop_spec _ _ _ E1), (IH _ _ _ E2). reflexivity.
Qed.

(* pop one whole 3-cell block if the first run has one, else three cells *)
Definition pop3 (s:sd) : list Sym * sd := match s with
  | (u, n)::rest => if Nat.eqb (length u) 3 then if N.leb 1 n then
      (u, if N.eqb n 1 then rest else (u, N.pred n)::rest) else take 3 s else take 3 s
  | [] => take 3 s end.
Lemma pop3_spec s cs s': pop3 s = (cs, s') -> sdn s = cs *> sdn s'.
Proof.
  destruct s as [|[u n] rest]; cbn [pop3]; [apply take_spec|].
  destruct (Nat.eqb (length u) 3); [|apply take_spec].
  destruct (N.leb_spec 1 n); [|apply take_spec].
  intros E; injection E as <- <-. cbn [sdn].
  destruct (N.eqb_spec n 1) as [->|Hn]; [apply lpow1|].
  cbn [sdn]. replace (N.to_nat n) with (S (N.to_nat (N.pred n))) by lia.
  cbn [lpow]. rewrite Str_app_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* window simulation; fl = true mirrors the moves; wl = cells behind the head (nearest first), wr = cells ahead *)
Fixpoint wsim (fuel:nat) (q:Q) (wl:list Sym) (h:Sym) (wr:list Sym) (fl:bool) : option (Q * list Sym) :=
  match fuel with O => None | S f =>
  match tm (q, h) with
  | None => None
  | Some (y, d, q') =>
    if (match d with R => negb fl | L => fl end) then
      match wr with [] => Some (q', y::wl) | z::wr' => wsim f q' (y::wl) z wr' fl end
    else match wl with [] => None | z::wl' => wsim f q' wl' z (y::wr) fl end
  end end.

Definition wden (fl:bool) (q:Q) (wl:list Sym) (h:Sym) (wr:list Sym) (bk fw:side) : Q * tape :=
  if fl then (q, (wr *> fw, h, wl *> bk)) else (q, (wl *> bk, h, wr *> fw)).
Definition wout (fl:bool) (q:Q) (out:list Sym) (bk fw:side) : Q * tape :=
  if fl then fw <{{q}} out *> bk else (out *> bk) {{q}}> fw.

Lemma wsim_spec fuel: forall q wl h wr fl q' out, wsim fuel q wl h wr fl = Some (q', out) ->
  forall bk fw, wden fl q wl h wr bk fw -->* wout fl q' out bk fw.
Proof.
  induction fuel as [|f IH]; intros q wl h wr fl q' out E bk fw; cbn [wsim] in E; [discriminate|].
  destruct (tm (q, h)) as [[[y d] q1]|] eqn:T; [|discriminate].
  destruct d, fl; cbn in E; cbn [wden wout].
  - destruct wr as [|z wr'].
    + injection E as <- <-. eapply evstep_step. 1: eapply (step_left T). cbn. apply evstep_refl.
    + eapply evstep_step. 1: eapply (step_left T). cbn. apply (IH _ _ _ _ true _ _ E bk fw).
  - destruct wl as [|z wl']; [discriminate|].
    eapply evstep_step. 1: eapply (step_left T). cbn. apply (IH _ _ _ _ false _ _ E bk fw).
  - destruct wl as [|z wl']; [discriminate|].
    eapply evstep_step. 1: eapply (step_right T). cbn. apply (IH _ _ _ _ true _ _ E bk fw).
  - destruct wr as [|z wr'].
    + injection E as <- <-. eapply evstep_step. 1: eapply (step_right T). cbn. apply evstep_refl.
    + eapply evstep_step. 1: eapply (step_right T). cbn. apply (IH _ _ _ _ false _ _ E bk fw).
Qed.

Definition try_k (k:nat) (q:Q) (sa:sd) (x:list Sym) (fl:bool) : option (list Sym * list Sym * sd) :=
  let (dc, sa2) := take k sa in
  match x with [] => None | h::xr =>
  match wsim 64 q dc h xr fl with
  | Some (q', out) => if qeqb q' q then if lsym_eqb (firstn k out) dc then Some (dc, skipn k out, sa2) else None else None
  | None => None end end.

Definition rule_ok (fl:bool) (q:Q) (x dc x2:list Sym) : Prop :=
  if fl then forall l r, l <* x <{{q}} dc *> r -->* l <{{q}} dc *> x2 *> r
  else forall l r, l <* dc {{q}}> x *> r -->* l <* x2 <* dc {{q}}> r.

Lemma try_k_spec k q sa x fl dc x2 sa2: try_k k q sa x fl = Some (dc, x2, sa2) ->
  sdn sa = dc *> sdn sa2 /\ rule_ok fl q x dc x2.
Proof.
  unfold try_k. destruct (take k sa) as [dc0 sa0] eqn:Et.
  destruct x as [|h xr]; [discriminate|].
  destruct (wsim 64 q dc0 h xr fl) as [[q' out]|] eqn:Ew; [|discriminate].
  destruct (qeqb q' q) eqn:Eq; [|discriminate]. apply qeqb_eq in Eq. subst q'.
  destruct (lsym_eqb (firstn k out) dc0) eqn:El; [|discriminate]. apply lsym_eqb_eq in El.
  intros E; injection E as <- <- <-. split; [apply (take_spec _ _ _ _ Et)|].
  pose proof (wsim_spec _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ew) as W.
  assert (Ho: out = dc0 ++ skipn k out) by (rewrite <-El; symmetry; apply firstn_skipn).
  destruct fl; unfold rule_ok; intros l r.
  - specialize (W r l). unfold wden, wout in W. rewrite Ho, Str_app_assoc in W. exact W.
  - specialize (W l r). unfold wden, wout in W. rewrite Ho, Str_app_assoc in W. exact W.
Qed.

Definition try3 q sa x fl : option (list Sym * list Sym * sd) :=
  match try_k 0 q sa x fl with Some r => Some r | None =>
  match try_k 1 q sa x fl with Some r => Some r | None => try_k 2 q sa x fl end end.
Lemma try3_spec q sa x fl dc x2 sa2: try3 q sa x fl = Some (dc, x2, sa2) ->
  sdn sa = dc *> sdn sa2 /\ rule_ok fl q x dc x2.
Proof.
  unfold try3. destruct (try_k 0 q sa x fl) eqn:E0; [intros Ex; injection Ex as ->; exact (try_k_spec _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ E0)|].
  destruct (try_k 1 q sa x fl) eqn:E1; [intros Ex; injection Ex as ->; exact (try_k_spec _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ E1)|].
  apply try_k_spec.
Qed.

Fixpoint pushl (dc:list Sym) (s:sd) : sd := match dc with [] => s | c::dc' => push_block (pushl dc' s) [c] 1%N end.
Lemma pushl_spec dc s: sdn (pushl dc s) = dc *> sdn s.
Proof. induction dc as [|c dc IH]; cbn [pushl]; [reflexivity|]. rewrite push_block_spec, IH. reflexivity. Qed.

Inductive dn := DL | DR.
Definition cfg := (Q * sd * sd * dn)%type.
Definition cdn (c:cfg) : Q * tape := let '(q, Ls, Rs, d) := c in
  match d with DR => sdn Ls {{q}}> sdn Rs | DL => sdn Ls <{{q}} sdn Rs end.

Definition try_rule (c:cfg) : option cfg :=
  let '(q, Ls, Rs, d) := c in
  match d with
  | DR => match Rs with [] => None | (x,n)::rest =>
     if N.leb 2 n then if Nat.leb 2 (length x) then
       match try3 q Ls x false with Some (dc, x2, L2) => Some (q, pushl dc (push_block L2 x2 n), rest, DR) | None => None end
     else None else None end
  | DL => match Ls with [] => None | (x,n)::rest =>
     if N.leb 2 n then if Nat.leb 2 (length x) then
       match try3 q Rs x true with Some (dc, x2, R2) => Some (q, rest, pushl dc (push_block R2 x2 n), DL) | None => None end
     else None else None end
  end.

Lemma try_rule_spec c c': try_rule c = Some c' -> cdn c -->* cdn c'.
Proof.
  destruct c as [[[q Ls] Rs] d]. destruct d; cbn [try_rule].
  - destruct Ls as [|[x n] rest]; [discriminate|].
    destruct (N.leb 2 n); [|discriminate]. destruct (Nat.leb 2 (length x)); [|discriminate].
    destruct (try3 q Rs x true) as [[[dc x2] R2]|] eqn:Et; [|discriminate].
    intros E; injection E as <-. apply try3_spec in Et as [Hs Hr].
    cbn [cdn sdn]. rewrite Hs, pushl_spec, push_block_spec.
    apply (shift_rule_L dc tm x x2 q Hr).
  - destruct Rs as [|[x n] rest]; [discriminate|].
    destruct (N.leb 2 n); [|discriminate]. destruct (Nat.leb 2 (length x)); [|discriminate].
    destruct (try3 q Ls x false) as [[[dc x2] L2]|] eqn:Et; [|discriminate].
    intros E; injection E as <-. apply try3_spec in Et as [Hs Hr].
    cbn [cdn sdn]. rewrite Hs, pushl_spec, push_block_spec.
    apply (shift_rule_R dc tm x x2 q Hr).
Qed.

Inductive mres := MOk (c:cfg) | MHalt.
Definition single (c:cfg) : mres :=
  let '(q, Ls, Rs, d) := c in
  match d with
  | DR => let (z, Rs') := pop Rs in
     match tm (q, z) with None => MHalt
     | Some (y, R, q') => MOk (q', push Ls y, Rs', DR)
     | Some (y, L, q') => MOk (q', Ls, push Rs' y, DL) end
  | DL => let (z, Ls') := pop Ls in
     match tm (q, z) with None => MHalt
     | Some (y, L, q') => MOk (q', Ls', push Rs y, DL)
     | Some (y, R, q') => MOk (q', push Ls' y, Rs, DR) end
  end.
Definition mstep (c:cfg) : mres := match try_rule c with Some c' => MOk c' | None => single c end.
Definition mok (c:cfg) (r:mres) : Prop := match r with MOk c' => cdn c -->* cdn c' | MHalt => halts tm (cdn c) end.

Lemma single_spec c: mok c (single c).
Proof.
  destruct c as [[[q Ls] Rs] d]. destruct d; cbn [single].
  - destruct (pop Ls) as [z Ls'] eqn:Ep. apply pop_spec in Ep.
    destruct (tm (q, z)) as [[[y [|]] q']|] eqn:T; cbn [mok cdn]; rewrite Ep.
    + eapply evstep_step. 1: eapply (step_left T). cbn. rewrite push_spec. apply evstep_refl.
    + eapply evstep_step. 1: eapply (step_right T). cbn. rewrite push_spec. apply evstep_refl.
    + apply halted_halts. exact T.
  - destruct (pop Rs) as [z Rs'] eqn:Ep. apply pop_spec in Ep.
    destruct (tm (q, z)) as [[[y [|]] q']|] eqn:T; cbn [mok cdn]; rewrite Ep.
    + eapply evstep_step. 1: eapply (step_left T). cbn. rewrite push_spec. apply evstep_refl.
    + eapply evstep_step. 1: eapply (step_right T). cbn. rewrite push_spec. apply evstep_refl.
    + apply halted_halts. exact T.
Qed.

Lemma mstep_spec c: mok c (mstep c).
Proof.
  unfold mstep. destruct (try_rule c) eqn:E; [apply try_rule_spec, E|apply single_spec].
Qed.

(** * K-forms *)
Definition B001 : list Sym := [S0;S0;S1].
Fixpoint eat001 (fuel:nat) (s:sd) : N * sd := match fuel with O => (0%N, s) | S f =>
  match s with
  | [] => (0%N, s)
  | (u, n)::rest => if lsym_eqb u B001 then let (m, s') := eat001 f rest in ((n+m)%N, s') else
       let (cs, s1) := pop3 s in
       if lsym_eqb cs B001 then let (m, s') := eat001 f s1 in (N.succ m, s') else (0%N, s)
  end end.
Lemma eat001_spec fuel: forall s m s', eat001 fuel s = (m, s') -> sdn s = B001^^(N.to_nat m) *> sdn s'.
Proof.
  induction fuel as [|f IH]; intros s m s' E; cbn [eat001] in E.
  - injection E as <- <-. reflexivity.
  - destruct s as [|[u n] rest]; [injection E as <- <-; reflexivity|].
    destruct (lsym_eqb u B001) eqn:Eu.
    + apply lsym_eqb_eq in Eu. subst u. destruct (eat001 f rest) as [m1 s1] eqn:E1. injection E as <- <-.
      cbn [sdn]. rewrite (IH _ _ _ E1), N2Nat.inj_add, lpow_add, Str_app_assoc. reflexivity.
    + destruct (pop3 ((u, n) :: rest)) as [cs s1] eqn:E3.
      destruct (lsym_eqb cs B001) eqn:Ec; [|injection E as <- <-; reflexivity].
      apply lsym_eqb_eq in Ec. subst cs. destruct (eat001 f s1) as [m1 s2] eqn:E1. injection E as <- <-.
      rewrite (pop3_spec _ _ _ E3), (IH _ _ _ E1), N2Nat.inj_succ. reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint allzero (s:sd) : bool := match s with [] => true | (u,_)::r => if allz u then allzero r else false end.
Lemma allzero_spec s: allzero s = true -> sdn s = const S0.
Proof.
  induction s as [|[u n] r IH]; cbn; [reflexivity|].
  destruct (allz u) eqn:H; [|discriminate]. intros H2. rewrite IH by exact H2.
  apply lpow_all0, allz_spec, H.
Qed.

Definition isK (c:cfg) : option (sd * N * N) :=
  let '(q, Ls, Rs, d) := c in
  match d with DL => None | DR =>
  if qeqb q E then
    let (y, L1) := pop Ls in
    if seqb y S0 then
      let (h3, R1) := pop3 Rs in
      if lsym_eqb h3 [S1;S0;S1] then
        let (b, R2) := eat001 100 R1 in
        let (g4, R3) := take 4 R2 in
        if lsym_eqb g4 [S0;S0;S0;S1] then
          let (cc, R4) := eat001 100 R3 in
          if allzero R4 then Some (L1, b, cc) else None
        else None else None else None else None end.

Lemma isK_spec c w b cc: isK c = Some (w, b, cc) -> cdn c = K (sdn w) (N.to_nat b) (N.to_nat cc).
Proof.
  destruct c as [[[q Ls] Rs] d]. destruct d; cbn [isK]; [discriminate|].
  destruct (qeqb q E) eqn:Eq; [|discriminate]. apply qeqb_eq in Eq. subst q.
  destruct (pop Ls) as [y L1] eqn:Ep. destruct (seqb y S0) eqn:Ey; [|discriminate]. apply seqb_eq in Ey. subst y.
  destruct (pop3 Rs) as [h3 R1] eqn:E3. destruct (lsym_eqb h3 [S1;S0;S1]) eqn:Eh; [|discriminate].
  apply lsym_eqb_eq in Eh. subst h3.
  destruct (eat001 100 R1) as [b1 R2] eqn:Eb. destruct (take 4 R2) as [g4 R3] eqn:Eg.
  destruct (lsym_eqb g4 [S0;S0;S0;S1]) eqn:Eg4; [|discriminate]. apply lsym_eqb_eq in Eg4. subst g4.
  destruct (eat001 100 R3) as [c1 R4] eqn:Ec. destruct (allzero R4) eqn:Ez; [|discriminate].
  intros E; injection E as <- <- <-.
  cbn [cdn]. unfold K, bellw.
  rewrite (pop_spec _ _ _ Ep), (pop3_spec _ _ _ E3), (eat001_spec _ _ _ _ Eb), (take_spec _ _ _ _ Eg),
    (eat001_spec _ _ _ _ Ec), (allzero_spec _ Ez).
  rewrite !Str_app_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

(** * Running to the next K-form *)
Inductive res := Halt | Kf (w:sd) (b c:N) | Fuel (c:cfg).
Definition step1 (bmin:N) (c:cfg) : res := match mstep c with
  | MHalt => Halt
  | MOk c' => match isK c' with Some (w, b, cc) => if N.leb bmin b then Kf w b cc else Fuel c' | None => Fuel c' end end.
Fixpoint urun (bmin:N) (p:positive) (c:cfg) : res := match p with
  | xH => step1 bmin c
  | xO p' => match urun bmin p' c with Fuel c' => urun bmin p' c' | x => x end
  | xI p' => match step1 bmin c with Fuel c' => match urun bmin p' c' with Fuel c'' => urun bmin p' c'' | x => x end | x => x end
  end.
Definition rok (c:cfg) (r:res) : Prop := match r with
  | Halt => halts tm (cdn c)
  | Kf w b cc => cdn c -->* K (sdn w) (N.to_nat b) (N.to_nat cc)
  | Fuel c' => cdn c -->* cdn c' end.

Lemma rok_trans c c' r: cdn c -->* cdn c' -> rok c' r -> rok c r.
Proof.
  intros H1 H2. destruct r; cbn [rok] in *.
  - eapply halts_evstep; eauto.
  - eapply evstep_trans; eauto.
  - eapply evstep_trans; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma step1_spec bmin c: rok c (step1 bmin c).
Proof.
  unfold step1. pose proof (mstep_spec c) as M. destruct (mstep c) as [c'|]; cbn [mok] in M; [|exact M].
  destruct (isK c') as [[[w b] cc]|] eqn:Ek; [|exact M].
  destruct (N.leb bmin b); [|exact M]. cbn [rok]. rewrite <-(isK_spec _ _ _ _ Ek). exact M.
Qed.

Lemma urun_spec bmin p: forall c, rok c (urun bmin p c).
Proof.
  induction p as [p IH|p IH|]; intros c; cbn [urun].
  - pose proof (step1_spec bmin c) as S1. destruct (step1 bmin c) as [| | c']; try exact S1.
    pose proof (IH c') as S2. destruct (urun bmin p c') as [| | c'']; try exact (rok_trans _ _ _ S1 S2).
    exact (rok_trans _ _ _ S1 (rok_trans _ _ _ S2 (IH c''))).
  - pose proof (IH c) as S1. destruct (urun bmin p c) as [| | c']; try exact S1.
    exact (rok_trans _ _ _ S1 (IH c')).
  - apply step1_spec.
Qed.

(** * The checker *)
Definition krec := (sd * N * N)%type.
Definition kden (k:krec) : Q * tape := let '(w, b, c) := k in K (sdn w) (N.to_nat b) (N.to_nat c).
Definition bellsd (b c:N) : sd := [([S1;S0;S1],1%N); (B001,b); ([S0;S0;S0;S1],1%N); (B001,c)].
Definition kcfg (k:krec) : cfg := let '(w, b, c) := k in (E, push w S0, bellsd b c, DR).
Lemma kcfg_spec k: cdn (kcfg k) = kden k.
Proof.
  destruct k as [[w b] c]. cbn [kcfg cdn kden bellsd sdn]. rewrite push_spec.
  unfold K, bellw. rewrite !lpow1, !Str_app_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Definition dg_of (cs:list Sym) : option dg := match cs with
  | [S1;S0;S0] => Some Dm | [S0;S0;S0] => Some D0 | [S1;S0;S1] => Some D1 | [S0;S0;S1] => Some D2 | _ => None end.
Lemma dg_of_spec cs d: dg_of cs = Some d -> cs = dcell d.
Proof.
  intros E. destruct cs as [|a cs]; [discriminate|].
  destruct cs as [|b cs]; [destruct a; cbn in E; discriminate|].
  destruct cs as [|c cs]; [destruct a, b; cbn in E; discriminate|].
  destruct cs as [|x cs]; [|destruct a, b, c; cbn in E; discriminate].
  destruct a, b, c; cbn in E; try discriminate; injection E as <-; reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint split (k:nat) (s:sd) : list dg * sd := match k with O => ([], s) | S k' =>
  let (cs, s1) := pop3 s in
  match dg_of cs with Some d => let (D, H) := split k' s1 in (d::D, H) | None => ([], s) end end.
Lemma split_spec k: forall s D H, split k s = (D, H) -> sdn s = cells D *> sdn H.
Proof.
  induction k as [|k IH]; intros s D H E; cbn [split] in E; [injection E as <- <-; reflexivity|].
  destruct (pop3 s) as [cs s1] eqn:E3. destruct (dg_of cs) as [d|] eqn:Ed; [|injection E as <- <-; reflexivity].
  destruct (split k s1) as [D1 H1] eqn:E1. injection E as <- <-.
  rewrite (pop3_spec _ _ _ E3), (IH _ _ _ E1), (dg_of_spec _ _ Ed). cbn [cells]. rewrite Str_app_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

Fixpoint pushd (D:list dg) (H:sd) : sd := match D with [] => H | d::D' => push_block (pushd D' H) (dcell d) 1%N end.
Lemma pushd_spec D H: sdn (pushd D H) = cells D *> sdn H.
Proof.
  induction D as [|d D IH]; cbn [pushd cells]; [reflexivity|].
  rewrite push_block_spec, lpow1, IH, Str_app_assoc. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* untrusted proposal: the number of clean increments before the carry leaves D *)
Definition propose (D:list dg) (b:N) : N := N.min b (Z.to_N (maxv (length D) - val D)%Z).

Definition batch (k:krec) : option krec :=
  let '(w, b, c) := k in
  let (D, H) := split 16 w in
  let n := propose D b in
  if N.eqb n 0 then None else
  if N.leb n b then
    match addn D (Z.of_N n) with
    | Some D' => Some (pushd D' H, (b - n)%N, (c + n)%N)
    | None => None end
  else None.

Lemma batch_spec k k': batch k = Some k' -> kden k -->* kden k'.
Proof.
  destruct k as [[w b] c]. unfold batch. destruct (split 16 w) as [D H] eqn:Es.
  destruct (N.eqb (propose D b) 0); [discriminate|].
  destruct (N.leb_spec (propose D b) b) as [Hb|]; [|discriminate].
  destruct (addn D (Z.of_N (propose D b))) as [D'|] eqn:Ea; [|discriminate].
  intros E; injection E as <-.
  apply addn_spec in Ea as [L V].
  cbn [kden]. rewrite (split_spec _ _ _ _ Es), pushd_spec.
  pose proof (rounds (N.to_nat (propose D b)) D D' (sdn H) (N.to_nat (b - propose D b)) (N.to_nat c) L) as R.
  replace (N.to_nat b) with (N.to_nat (propose D b) + N.to_nat (b - propose D b))%nat by lia.
  replace (N.to_nat (c + propose D b)) with (N.to_nat (propose D b) + N.to_nat c)%nat by lia.
  apply R. lia.
Qed.

Definition FUEL : positive := 65535%positive.
Definition fromres (k:krec) (r:res) : krec + unit := match r with
  | Kf w b c => inl (w, b, c) | Halt => inr tt | Fuel _ => inl k end.
Definition next (k:krec) : krec + unit :=
  let '(w, b, c) := k in
  if N.eqb b 0 then fromres k (urun 1 FUEL (kcfg k))
  else match batch k with Some k' => inl k' | None => fromres k (urun 0 FUEL (kcfg k)) end.

Lemma fromres_spec k r: rok (kcfg k) r ->
  match fromres k r with inl k' => kden k -->* kden k' | inr _ => halts tm (kden k) end.
Proof.
  destruct r as [|w b c|c']; cbn [fromres rok]; rewrite kcfg_spec; intros H.
  - exact H.
  - exact H.
  - apply evstep_refl.
Qed.

Lemma next_spec k: match next k with inl k' => kden k -->* kden k' | inr _ => halts tm (kden k) end.
Proof.
  unfold next. destruct k as [[w b] c].
  destruct (N.eqb b 0); [apply fromres_spec, urun_spec|].
  destruct (batch (w, b, c)) as [k'|] eqn:Eb; [apply batch_spec, Eb|].
  apply fromres_spec, urun_spec.
Qed.

Definition run (T:N) (k:krec) : krec + unit := N_iter_until next (inl k) T.
Lemma run_ok T k k': run T k = inl k' -> kden k -->* kden k'.
Proof.
  intros E. pose proof (@N_iter_until_spec krec unit next (inl k) T
    (fun x => kden k -->* kden x) (fun _ => halts tm (kden k))) as H.
  assert (Hstep: forall x, kden k -->* kden x ->
    match next x with inl x' => kden k -->* kden x' | inr _ => halts tm (kden k) end).
  { intros x Ex. pose proof (next_spec x) as I. destruct (next x).
    - eapply evstep_trans; eauto.
    - eapply halts_evstep; [exact I|exact Ex]. }
  specialize (H Hstep (evstep_refl _ _)). unfold run in E. rewrite E in H. exact H.
Qed.
Lemma run_halt T k: run T k = inr tt -> halts tm (kden k).
Proof.
  intros E. pose proof (@N_iter_until_spec krec unit next (inl k) T
    (fun x => kden k -->* kden x) (fun _ => halts tm (kden k))) as H.
  assert (Hstep: forall x, kden k -->* kden x ->
    match next x with inl x' => kden k -->* kden x' | inr _ => halts tm (kden k) end).
  { intros x Ex. pose proof (next_spec x) as I. destruct (next x).
    - eapply evstep_trans; eauto.
    - eapply halts_evstep; [exact I|exact Ex]. }
  specialize (H Hstep (evstep_refl _ _)). unfold run in E. rewrite E in H. exact H.
Qed.

Definition k0 : krec := ([], 0%N, 2%N).
Lemma init: c0 -->* kden k0.
Proof. unfold kden, k0, K, bellw; cbn. solve_init. Qed.

(** literal chunk states: a block is a positive, cells from the lowest bit, the top bit a sentinel *)
Fixpoint pcells (p:positive) : list Sym := match p with xH => [] | xO p' => S0 :: pcells p' | xI p' => S1 :: pcells p' end.
Definition ncells (n:N) : list Sym := match n with N0 => [] | Npos p => pcells p end.
Fixpoint mksd (l:list N) : sd := match l with u::n::l' => (ncells u, n) :: mksd l' | _ => [] end.
Definition mk (l:list N) (b c:N) : krec := (mksd l, b, c).
